baud.description: The baud rate for the serial device. Must be one of: 300, 1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, 115200.

logfile.description: The absolute path to the file where ttylog output is redirected.

flush.description: If true, enables the --flush option to output buffers after every write.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. If 0, ttylog runs indefinitely.

extra_args.description: List of additional command-line arguments to append to the ttylog command.
